changelog:
Initial release of AI Dev Runtime — a toolkit for efficient, memory-enhanced code development.

- Combines file operations (read, search, edit), terminal execution, and test running in one workflow.
- Features hybrid semantic-keyword code search and adaptive learning memory for improved results over time.
- Includes tools for full dev task automation, bug-fixing workflows, multi-step coding, and advanced codebase analysis.
- Offers practical guidance and usage tips for higher workflow accuracy.
- Requires a running AiDevRuntime HTTP server; supports custom server URL and API keys.
